title: Clarify CSV rerun waiting progress
summary: Clarified active CSV rerun waiting states so idle-between-items backend text is not promoted as active current-work evidence, and the WebView Run Progress timeline keeps focus on CSV import/waiting progress instead of final Run evidence review.
reason: During CSV rerun gaps between nested pipeline chunks, the UI could show the pipeline as idle/waiting while marking Run evidence as current/review, making a normal wait for the next CSV item look broken or paused.
behavior_before: An idle/waiting progress snapshot could produce active current-work evidence, and the WebView timeline could focus Run evidence/review while CSV rerun work was still active between items.
behavior_after: Idle/waiting current-work text is reported as idle, latest events remain available as event evidence, and active CSV rerun stdout/worker evidence keeps the Run Progress timeline focused on CSV import/waiting progress with specific CSV rerun status.
manual_validation: .\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe -m unittest tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_web_static -q - failed: existing unrelated dirty-worktree static assertions for launch tab order and pending-publish local_file allowlist
rollback_plan: Revert the current-work presentation change, the progressView.js CSV rerun timeline/status adjustments, the two regression test additions, and the regenerated summaries listed in this packet.
notes:

Add WebView CSV rerun waiting timeline regression coverage.
Add backend idle/waiting current-work regression coverage.
